title: Vibrant Vegan Dutch Bowl
description: A colorful and nutritious bowl filled with marinated tofu, roasted vegetables, and a tangy sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cut the carrots and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
Place the tofu on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the tofu and season with salt and pepper.
Roast the tofu in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the tofu is roasting, toast the mixed greens in a large bowl.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and add to the bowl.
Slice the roasted tofu into thin strips and add to the bowl.
Drizzle the apple cider vinegar over the salad and toss to combine.
